content.body: The DB7 was the French export version of the US-built Douglas Boston series. It was designed as a fast nimble attack aircraft, and doubled as an intruder. With a good bombload and forward firing guns it was very effective in the attack role.
content.brief: TYPE: Attack Bomber CREW: 3 WEIGHT:7587 kg MAX SPEED: 510 kph ARMAMENT: 4 X 7.5mm MAC LMG 2 x 7.9mm Browning LMG 944kg bomb load
content.title: Douglas DB-7
